newsitem.title: USA: Fuqua CEO sees 1997 profit at least $2/shr.
newsitem.headline: Fuqua CEO sees 1997 profit at least $2/shr.

text.p: Fuqua Enterprises Inc's chief executive officer said Wednesday he expects 1997 full year earnings per share of at least $2.00, up from $1.60 to $1.65 in 1996.
"We should be able to equal or exceed two dollars (for 1997)," Lawrence Klamon said in an interview after he addressed the Atlanta Society of Financial Analysts.

Earlier in his address, he said, "We estimate we will come in somehwere between $1.60 and 1.65" per share for the full year of 1996. Fuqua Enterprises is a leather supplier to manufacturers and a maker of medical equipment.
